preconditions.description: Input constraints: n, d are between 1 and 1000, k is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: stdin.strip().split() == ['-1'] or (len(stdin.strip().split()) == 3 and all(s.isdigit() for s in stdin.strip().split()))
preconditions.description: Input is either '-1' or three integers n, k, d.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' if (n > k ** d) else (len(stdout.strip().split()) == d * n and all(s.isdigit() for s in stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: If no valid arrangement exists (n > k^d), output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is d lines of n integers each, representing bus assignments for each student on each day.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(bus) <= k for line in stdout.strip().split('\n') if line for bus in line.split())
postconditions.description: Every bus assignment is between 1 and k (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(not (all(int(stdout.strip().split()[i + j * n]) == int(stdout.strip().split()[i + j * n + 1]) for j in range(d)) for i in range(n - 1)) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True)
postconditions.description: No two distinct students share the same bus on all d days (i.e., no two students are in the same buses for every day).
